title:
O, he did. Into her. She did. Done.
 
 Ah!
html_source:
Bloom’s perfunctory, poignant evocation of Molly’s adultery again allows the following ‘Ah!’ to be recontextualised as both poignant, fleeting despair, and a blustering, dismissive ‘Ah!’ that precedes his practical consideration of his wet shirt.

His own maturbation is contrasted with Boylan’s sex with Molly, which precedes the later, more graphic evocation of his seeming titillation at being cuckolded in the Circe chapter.
